tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'di nang gtor bzlog dang mdos sogs kyi dmod bcol bzhugs so// swasti/ lo rim sogs la gtor bzlog dgos tshe/ bzlog dmigs gtso che bas/ sngon las 'phral rkyen las gyur pa'i dgra bos mthu gtad sogs byas pa'am/ gza' klu rgyal sogs bgegs rigs kyi sdang zhing gdug rtsub cho 'phrul nus pa thams cad zor chen rdzas kyi nus pas phyir bzlog nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gyur par bsam pa las rnam shes mar me lta bu'i bsad pa'i dmigs pa ni ma dgos pas/ de mtshungs dmod bcol yang sngags rnams bzlas tshar rjes/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin rigs brgyud/ snyan nas snyan brgyud/ rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ khro bcu yab yum/ khra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng / bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi sogs yi dam chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis bstan 'gro'i sems can yongs la gnod pa dang / khyad par gdan sa chen po'i dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang dang / mgon khang rnams na bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog gi mchod gtor/ bla mchod rgyud 'don/ sgrub mchod gtor bzlog mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'dus sde'i phogs/ zhib tshugs/ sde bstan pa sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thabs su dmigs phyag mdzod tshogs bdag dang / phun tshogs yongs 'du'i gnyer tshang dang / chos sde nyi zla zung gi spyi mdzod chen mo/ mi sde kun gyi lo thog la sngon las 'phral rkyen las gyur pa'i dgra bgegs rnams bsam sbyor ngan pa'i sad/ ser/ btsa'/ than/ 'bu sogs lo dgra ji snyed gtong ba thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis bzlog tu gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis mi thul pa'i gdug pa can bstan 'gro'i dgra bgegs las ngan bsags pa rnams lo zla ma 'gyang bar myur du sgrol la rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su rjes su bzung ste/

gnod bya gnod byed thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod/ de bzhin sger pa lta bu'i rim gro yin na dmigs zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la sde dge phur pa bla ma zhes sam sman pa bla ma'i sger la zhes sogs/ stod smad bar gang gi'ang ming 'gyur nas mi la na tsha/ nor la god kha/ dgra jag sogs 'bul sdud kha 'gog ji snyed sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin tshogs khag la'ang dgu gtor tshogs pa'i sogs/ gzhung mgron tshang pa'i sgar sogs thams cad la rigs 'gre bsgyur/ de bzhin 'brog khag god la'ang / kha'u 'brog sde'i kom kre 'brog sde'am/ gzung gos ru ba'am/ 'bum thang dkar ru'i sogs 'gre'o/ /yang sbyin bdag gzhan la yin na/ gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang pa'i chos srid la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rigs ji snyed sogs/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos srid la sogs/ sde dge sa dbang mchog gi chos srid la sogs/ cha zhabs kham drung gi grong gras ming 'di zhes bya ba'i mi la sogs/ de bzhin yul chen mchog dkar nas 'dam thog bar stod smad bar gsum chos bzhin gang la'ang rigs 'gre/ 'on kyang grong ming ma shes na/ sde mtshon gyi ming dper na shab gzhung khul na gnas pa'i dmigs yul 'di'i mi la sogs de thams cad la dmigs bsal dgos na ma gtogs 'bul ba'i kha 'gog zer ma dgos pas dgra jag sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ nad la dmigs bsal yin na 'go yams ma rungs pa/ zas spyod sman gyis gsos dka' zhing / nad kyi ming tsam thos pas skrag par byed pa rnams zhi ba'i thabs sogs gong bzhin/ zhes pa 'di yang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing lug lo dpal sa skya'i gnyer tshang nas lo rim phur bzlog bgyis skabs sa skya pa kun blos dran tshad bris pa'o/ ༈ /yang gsar dran/ gur zhal sogs kyi gtor bzlog gam/ 'jigs byed sogs la'ang so so'i mtshan bsgyur/ sgrol ma g.yul mdos sogs la zur na bris yod par 'di nas kyang gang dgos blangs pas chog cing /

blo dman rang dang 'dra ba'i re bskong yong nges shing / mkhas grub rnams ni smos ma dgos pas/ bstan 'gro'i ched bka' rtsom mdzad par yang kha tsam min par gsol 'debs so/ /zla 2tshes 20la/ sgrol ma'i mdos dmod bcol ni sgrol ma'i yi ge bcu pa/ rta mgrin gyi sngags/ bha ya na gsum trig raksha rnams kyi mthar 'khor 'das mgron chen rnams la sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod gtor klud yas gang la gang mnyes bden pa'i stobs dang / dad pa'i shugs kyis phul zhing / sngon gyi thugs dam bskul ba'i sgo nas phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad par gsol te/ mthar drag po'i zor rdzas bdud dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon char bsgyur ba 'di nyid bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten kun la gnod cing / 'tshe ba dang / khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid snod bcud mchog phal yongs la sdang zhing tho 'tshams pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs zhi bas 'dul bar mi nus shing / rgyal ba mngon spyod bya ba'i yul du bstan pa rnams kyi thog tu gnam lcags drag po 'babs pa'am/ bskal pa'i me dpung ltar gyur nas/ skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul du brlags nas bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'jig rten khams dang / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa 'gal rkyen spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ //ces brjod do// //zhes pa 'di yang sde dge sman pa bla ma dkon mchog grags pas bskul pa ltar sa skya pa kun blos kha 'chal don ldan yin no// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'di nang gtor bzlog dang mdos sogs kyi dmod bcol bzhugs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
